The '''Royal Pigeon''' is a {{Legendary}} item.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Royal Pigeon''' can be claimed once the player reaches [[Commissions|Commission Milestone V]], which requires at least {{Green|500}} {{zone|Dwarven Mines}}, {{zone|Crystal Hollows}} or {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}} [[Commissions]] to be completed.

== Usage ==
Every {{Green|5}} seconds, the player can use the '''Royal Pigeon''' to access the [[Commissions#Interface|Commissions menu]] remotely from within the {{zone|Dwarven Mines}}, {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}, {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}} or {{zone|Glacite Mineshafts}}.

{{:Emissary/UI}}

A '''Royal Pigeon''' can be returned to {{NPCSprite|Queen Mismyla}} to obtain her [[Abiphones#Contacts|Abiphone contact]].

== Tips ==
*It is possible to right click the '''Royal Pigeon''' and then quickly swap to a mining tool with {{Ench|Compact}} before the menu opens to increase your {{Skill|Mining}} XP gain while claiming [[Commissions]].

== Trivia ==
*The '''Royal Pigeon''' is a reference to the fact that [[w:Pigeon_post|carrier pigeons]] have been used as messengers for thousands of years.
*Despite the '''Royal Pigeon'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s ability being unavailable outside of the {{zone|Dwarven Mines}}, {{zone|Crystal Hollows}}, {{zone|Glacite Tunnels}} and {{zone|Glacite Mineshafts}}, calling {{NPCSprite|Queen Mismyla}} on an [[Abiphone]] will open the [[Commissions#Interface|Commissions menu]] regardless of the player's location.
* Trying to use the '''Royal Pigeon''' outside of the Dwarven Mines would previously display the message, "You may not use this Item outside the Dwarven Caves!".
